simple.meaning: עַצְלָה (ʻatslâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “(as abstractly) indolence.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עַצְלָה (H6103) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Proverbs 19:15, with occurrences in Proverbs, Ecclesiastes.

simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in עַצְלָה (H6103) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: עַצְלָה (ʻatslâh) / H6103 is traced through Proverbs 19:15, Ecclesiastes 10:18 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H6103. atslah עֵצְלָה noun feminine sluggishness ; — ׳י Prov 19:15 ; dual intensive עֲצַלְתַּיִם Eccl 10:18 double (i.e. great) sluggishness (so Thes De and others; read then perhaps עֵצְלָתַיִם ; > from עָצֵל a sluggish pair , i.e. hands Ew and others), but improbable; || יָדַיִם שִׁפְלוּת , whence Bi conjectures עֵצְלוּת , Siegf יָדַיִם עֵצְלַת .
